auto_approve._modes: off | shadow (gate + runner run, 'would approve' logged, nothing posted) | live (APPROVE posted as login)
auto_approve._scope_note: GitHub-Actions bumps under .github/workflows are hard-excluded in v1 (owner to decide); lock-only PRs are not eligible
auto_approve._ownership_note: Auto-approve applies only to PRs the user is asked to review: requested_reviewers contains login OR requested_teams intersects owner_teams. Repo-sweep rows never qualify (a sweep row is not a request — it may come from teams the user is not in).
auto_approve._docs_exclude_note: SKILL.md, skills/*/reference/**, agents/**, commands/**, WORKSPACE.md, CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md are Markdown but they are agent instructions: a change to them changes behaviour, so it is never docs-only. trivial-check.py enforces these exclusions even when a config omits them.

auto_comment._modes: off (default — opt in explicitly) | shadow (gate + review-runner run, ledger gets shadow_comment, the main session reports 'would comment' and nothing is posted) | live (a COMMENT review is posted as login, no walk)
auto_comment._prios_note: pr-scan queue rows whose PRIO is in this list are eligible — [1] is direct review requests only; a repo-sweep or team row is never prio 1
auto_comment._on_stop_note: hold (default) = a STOP finding posts nothing and leaves the PR as an ordinary queue row for the next interactive pr-review walk. comment = post a COMMENT review even with a STOP finding present (still never APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES — scope.md 'APPROVE is never inferred'). request_changes is accepted here as a config value but NOT implemented: no standing owner decision authorises an unattended REQUEST_CHANGES post, so the runner always falls back to hold behaviour and reports it as an owner question instead of guessing.
auto_comment._max_per_tick_note: cost cap — at most this many review-runner spawns (one Opus runner per PR) per pr-scan tick; the rest stay ordinary queue rows
